params.body:
The project settings listed every known running system on every project, with one sentence for all of them ("may be admitted to act"). Signal Observatory offered the Stocklist platform, and "act" is wrong for a system that is only read.

- `Capability::SYSTEM_INFO` gives each system a name and the repository it runs from.
- `systemsFor($project)` returns the systems whose repository the project links, plus any it already names, so unlinking a repository never hides a system that is switched on.
- Settings show only those, by name, with what can be admitted per layer: "read it, for 30 days" and/or "repair one item at a time, per day".
- On save, a system that does not belong to the project is dropped, even when posted.

Tests:

- One new case in `ReadLayerTest`.
- `ReadLayerTest` and `RepairLayerTest` pass.
- The full suite passes 625 of 626. The one failure, `BuildStampTest`, also fails without this change because it reads the git checkout.
- PHPStan reports 0 errors.
